title: Defenders #116 Marvel 1983 Son of Satan Hellstrom Cover Don Perlin Bronze Age
conditionDescription: Bright, glossy front cover. Small crease at the bottom left corner of the back cover, light toning on the back. See photos.
descriptionText:
The Defenders #116 (February 1983), Marvel Comics. Son of Satan (Daimon Hellstrom) cover by Don Perlin and Mitchell; the Overmind casts visions into the mind of Doctor Strange. With Beast, Namor, Valkyrie and Gargoyle. 60 cent cover price.

Back cover: LEGO Expert Builder Dune Buggy ad.

Condition: bright, glossy front cover; small crease at the bottom left corner of the back cover and light toning on the back (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
